about: PHASE-33 Q10 (b): the exact-quote case set on the synthetic bench chat (the S3 set: 32k context, played to turn 100). Every quote is said in turns 1-58, outside the prompt's window at turn 100; `turn` is the source turn as NMOS numbers it (0-based, as the packet and the Inspector show it) and `gold` the words said, verbatim in that turn. Synthetic text only. Run with tools/eval_rp.py against a bench database's recorded request at turn 100 (`trace` added locally).
